decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the two ticket counters and per-referral awards with Small Block-only values and removes both obsolete Big Block lifecycle keys.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already rewrites every FAQ attribute that advertised Big Block prizes or tickets while retaining unaffected generic winner-selection and reward information.
The existing message-195 MODIFY replaces the complete how-it-works copy with Small Block-only ticket and prize descriptions; the remaining Chainlink and reward statements remain valid.
The existing message-195 MODIFY captures the new $5 primary-mint contribution to the continuing Small Block pool, while the established $500 prize and draw condition remain unchanged.
Eliminating Big Block prizes does not change the established automatic wallet-transfer collection method or winner-wallet destination for the remaining Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY replaces the reward-components array with the $5 commission and Small Block ticket, thereby removing the obsolete Big Block ticket.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the royalty prize-pool destinations with Small Block only; the flat royalty and secondary-sale founder share remain unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible key while preserving the still-required Small Block counter, badges, and referral-code metadata.
The existing message-195 MODIFY replaces the prize-pool copy with a Small Block-only description and explicitly excludes advertising a Big Block prize.
The existing message-195 MODIFY fully captures the $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block pool allocation and replaces the pool destinations with Small Block only.
Prize-winner email notification remains required for the continuing Small Block prizes, and the email state contains no Big Block-specific content.
The generic hero reference to prize draw tickets remains accurate for Small Block tickets and does not advertise or require Big Block mechanics.
